descriptionHtml:
思路 / Approach · OAT-03 Retry/Timeout Resiliency · S17 「第一次尝试还在重试时又点 Generate，两个模式」 Tapping Generate again while the first attempt is still retrying, both contexts

覆盖的 UAT 步骤 / 票 AC：

  • U3 The physician's already-entered dictation / encounter text is preserved whether or not the note succeeded; the original input is never lost in any failure state（UAT OAT-03 step 4；UAT OAT-03 Expected Result 1；TFA-94745 AC 3；TFA-94745 state 4；TFA-94422 AC 5）
  • U2 If retries are exhausted, an explicit failure message appears (matching the prototype's 'NOTE NOT GENERATED' pattern; EFS: 'Note not generated' shown), never a blank note, a crash, a raw error pop-up …（UAT OAT-03 step 3；UAT OAT-03 Expected Result 1；UAT Empty & Failure States (Note generation failed)；TFA-94745 state 4；TFA-94745 AC 1；TFA-94745 AC 2；TFA-94422 AC 5；TFA-92568 AC 5）
  • U13 All of the above in both Hospital and Nursing Home, on web, iOS and Android（UAT 3.3；UAT Empty & Failure States Expected Result；TFA-94745 AC 6）

测试设计方法：错误推测（error-guessing） — 专门去撞最容易出错的地方（失败、重复点、两个标签页、时钟不对、注入的指令）。

Given Local stack with Haiku forced to fail (so the first call spends time in retries before Mistral answers); Hospital patient and Nursing Home resident, each with a typed dictation

When Double-tap Generate Note & Finish, then tap it once more while it still shows it is generating

Then One note is produced and saved; no duplicate note text and no second billing request for the same note; the dictation is unchanged

通过的标准（oracle，节选）：cp mustContain the note heading. Backend, read right after each chart (diagnostics:list keeps 8 rows per user): exactly one notes.generateNote ok row per chart in the run window; Hospital: exactly one notes.suggestBilling row for the note; one stored note per chart; encounterNotes unchanged

在哪跑：本地 probes（多端探针）；测试方法 PW · Playwright 脚本；矩阵里排的车道 浏览器 agent（blocked）

S17 是我们自己编的用例号（覆盖矩阵 cases/OAT-03.matrix.json 里的编号），不是 UAT 文档里的步骤号。

环境：本地 — main e02167f，本地栈（local stack, not a deployed build）；run folder runs/2026-10-14-local，lane probes。

测试方法：PW · Playwright 脚本；辅助：FAULT · 故障注入 — 按 cases/test-methods.json 的分类，分类说在 local 跑；来源：probes。

UAT item: OAT-03 Retry/Timeout Resiliency · Section: B · Operational Acceptance Tests · Scenario: OAT-03/S17

Tapping Generate again while the first attempt is still retrying, both contexts

Tickets: TFA-92568 Phase 4: Make it safe for real patients (in progress); TFA-94422 Haiku primary, Mistral fallback via Bedrock (ready for qa); TFA-94745 Empty & Failure States (ready for qa)

本地新 lane probes：probes/results.json 里 status blocked → 卡住（卡住）。

怎么测（probes/plan.json，automatable: partly）：Scripted probe both contexts: every generateNote request held 8 s at the socket (the retry window) then forwarded LIVE; double-click Generate, tap again while generating; count client generateNote requests, notes shown, stored note, dictation unchanged, aiCallLog generateNote / suggestBilling rows. — The retry delay is simulated at the socket, not by a failing Haiku; the double-tap guard and one-note/one-billing outcome are fully judged.

Detail:

Built (each generateNote held 8 s at the socket then forwarded live; double-click + extra tap; one note / one billing row). Generate / Regenerate is forbidden on the local target (scripts/capabilities.json, Quinn 2026-10-13; dev only). The spec is built and skips itself; run it with QA_ALLOW_LOCAL_GENERATE=1 once Quinn OKs local Generate.

证据：附了 0 个；没附 1 个：

  • web/qa-agent-tests/probes/oat03-generate-faults.spec.ts — 在本地跑测目录外，不附

Dev run: skipped: local-only — local-only — The given puts it on the local stack with Haiku forced to fail, so the first Generate spends its time in retries (BEDROCK_TEST_FAIL_MODEL, fault-ai).. This local result replaces that dev entry (the scenario appears once).
